Asset: RPG Characters - Nov 2020
Author: Quaternius
License: CC0 1.0 Universal
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-rpg-characters
Downloaded file: rpg_characters_-_nov_2020.zip

Selected cast: Warrior (player), Rogue (guard), Monk (brute), Wizard
(caster), and Cleric (boss). Each character keeps its native 44-bone
skeleton, hand-painted texture, equipment, and original animations.
No skeleton retargeting is used. The original FBX and texture inputs used
by tools/build_rpg_cast.py are retained under upstream/.
